def transform(grid):
    # The 8s mark the rectangular output window. Recover its contents
    # from the corresponding window rotated 180 degrees in the grid.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return [[grid[H - 1 - (r0 + i)][W - 1 - (c0 + j)]
             for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
